  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ [GMC1877-shutterstock_1799586823-IN-SHAPE.png] Burn wound management Burn wounds are a global
public health problem and a leading cause of morbidity, including prolonged hospitalisation,
disfigurement and disability – often accompanied by stigma and social rejection.¹ Our aim is to help
mitigate the complications associated with burn wounds. ][11] [
[HERO-ALLEVYN-LIFE-PIP-EXPLOSION-1000X1000PX-NO-BG.png] Pressure injury prevention Trusted to reduce
the incidence of pressure injuries when used as part of a comprehensive prevention program, compared
to standard care alone.^{1-3} ][12] [ [PartialThicknessTear_HeroCutout(24901)_20250211]
Partial-thickness rotator cuff tears Partial-thickness tears can have a lasting impact on pain and
shoulder function. When used in isolated bioinductive repair, the REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant
leads to tendon healing without the need for sutured repair;^{1-4} offering patients a faster
recovery and return to activity than sutured repairs.^{4,5} ][13] [ [CARTIHEAL Procedure page Hero
Image.png] Chondral and osteochondral knee repair Treat knee cartilage lesions and osteochondral
defects in a single-stage procedure, even in the presence of mild to moderate osteoarthritis
(Kellgren-Lawrence 0-3),^{1,2} with the porous, biocompatible CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage
Repair Implant; shown to be clinically superior to the current surgical standard of care in level 1
clinical data.^{*1,2} ][14]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
Celebrating 170 years
Life Unlimited
Sports Medicine
Ultimate victory

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

# Worldwide supplier of affordable medical disposables

Ace Medical Devices has been a trusted supplier of affordable medical disposables for over 15 years.
We specialize in [urology][36], [gastro endoscopy][37] and [surgical products][38] and we deliver
our supplies directly to hospitals and through our [worldwide network of partners][39].

### A proven reputation thanks to strict quality control

Over the past decade, ACE Medical Devices has built a stellar reputation by focusing on our
principle of quality first. When it comes to medical supplies, quality control is our first, second
and third priority. We aim to be competitively priced based on innovation, efficiency and scale.
This allowed us to build a strong network of distributing partners worldwide, who prove every day
that cost-effectiveness and proven quality can go hand in hand.

### Trust is our business model

We worked hard to establish our reputation as a reliable supplier of quality medical products, from
basic disposables to more advanced medical products. We are proud to be your long-term partner and
to put India on the map of high-quality medical device manufacturing.

[Read more][40]

Interested in what we can do for you?

[Request an introduction call now][41]
X

In what way would you like to partner with ACE Medical Devices?*
[Flag UnitedStates]
, ,

ACE Medical Devices understands the importance of quality and design. In what has been a very
effective partnership, we have been able to compete successfully against the highest quality
competitor again and again in head to head trials. We have been working with ACE since 2015 and
their constant product improvements has ensured that we are now perceived as the highest quality
producer of bipolar resection devices in the US market. We have sold many thousands of ACE’s
products without a single instance of failure and their deliveries from India have always been on
time. Our internal audits of ACE’s facilities have always passed, with minor suggestions or none at
all. We feel fortunate to have discovered ACE Medical Devices.

- Timothy, Distributor for ACE Medical Devices in United States

## Custom manufacturing

As an experienced developer of basic and advanced medical devices, we partner with inspired
individuals and organisations for the design, development and manufacturing of custom products,
whether they are new and innovative, or customised to meet your specific needs.


ISO 13485: 2016 certified production centre of Ace Medical Devices

### Order directly with us

Since Ace Medical Devices started in 2008, we have strategically chosen to work with distribution
partners around the world to maximize our reach. We are extremely proud of the bonds we forged with
our clients and our partners in over 20 countries and territories to which we ship our products
every single day.

If you are an independent health care provider, hospital or distributor of medical supplies, we are
also open to directly taking your order. Please [contact us][42] to know more.

[Flag UnitedKingdom]
, ,

We have been happy with the service and products received. Keep up the good work guys it makes our
job selling a good product easier.

- Grant, Distributor for Ace Medical Devices in United Kingdom

### Independently certified

Ace Medical Devices holds ISO 13485:2016 quality systems certification from some of the most
prestigious international institutes. We are an US FDA audited firm. Some of our products with
proprietary designs are US FDA 510k cleared for distribution in the United States, CE approved for
distribution in the Europe

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## Frequently asked questions

What is Healthmatters, and who is it for?

Healthmatters is a personal health dashboard that helps you organize and understand your lab
results. It collects and displays your medical test data from any lab in one secure, easy-to-use
platform.

Who should use Healthmatters?
* Individuals who want to track and understand their health over time.
* Health professionals, such as doctors, nutritionists, and wellness coaches, need to manage and
  interpret lab data for their clients.
What can I do with a Healthmatters account?

With a Healthmatters account, you can:
* Upload lab reports from any lab
* View your data in interactive graphs, tables, and timelines
* Track trends and monitor changes over time
* Customize your reference ranges
* Export and share your full lab history
* Access your results anytime, from any device

Professionals can also analyze client data more efficiently and save time managing lab reports.

What test results do you interpret?

Healthmatters.io personal account provides in-depth research on 10000+ biomarkers, including
information and suggestions for test panels such as, but not limited to:
* The GI Effects® Comprehensive Stool Profile,
* GI-MAP,
* The NutrEval FMV®,
* The ION Profile,
* Amino Acids Profile,
* Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones (DUTCH),
* Organic Acids Test,
* Organix Comprehensive Profile,
* Toxic Metals,
* Complete Blood Count (CBC),
* Metabolic panel,
* Thyroid panel,
* Lipid Panel,
* Urinalysis,
* And many, many more.

You can combine all test reports inside your Healthmatters account and keep them in one place. It
gives you an excellent overview of all your health data. Once you retest, you can add new results
and compare them.

If you are still determining whether Healthmatters support your lab results, the rule is that if you
can test it, you can upload it to Healthmatters.

Do you only accept reports from specific labs listed here?

While we work with many popular labs, we welcome reports from lots of other places too.

It's as simple as this: if you can get a test done, you can upload it to Healthmatters and we can
interpret results from any lab out there. If laboratories can analyze it, we can interpret it.

If you're on the hunt for a specific biomarker, [contact us][15] and we'll add it to our database.
Anything from blood, urine, saliva, or stool can be uploaded, understood, and tracked with your
Healthmatters account.

What's the difference between the Advanced and Unlimited plans, and who are they for?

The **Advanced Plan ($79/year)** is perfect for individuals who want ongoing access to their health
data. It includes unlimited self-entry of lab reports, visual tracking, custom ranges, result
explanations, full account exports, and secure sharing — all with a simple yearly subscription. The
plan also includes ** free data entry of up to 5 reports by our data entry team.** You can cancel
anytime and restart your plan whenever you're ready — your data will still be there waiting for you.
You can also upgrade to the Unlimited Plan at any time, with the cost prorated based on what you've
already paid.

** The Unlimited Plan ($250 one-time)** is also designed for individuals but offers lifetime access
with no ongoing subscription. You'll get all the same features as the Advanced Plan, plus **free
data entry of up to 10 reports by our data entry team**, making it a great choice if you prefer a
one-time payment and long-term use without yearly fees.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Healthmatters, and who is it for?

Healthmatters is a personal health dashboard that helps you organize and understand your lab
results. It collects and displays your medical test data from any lab in one secure, easy-to-use
platform.

Who should use Healthmatters?
* Individuals who want to track and understand their health over time.
* Health professionals, such as doctors, nutritionists, and wellness coaches, need to manage and
  interpret lab data for their clients.
What can I do with a Healthmatters account?

With a Healthmatters account, you can:
* Upload lab reports from any lab
* View your data in interactive graphs, tables, and timelines
* Track trends and monitor changes over time
* Customize your reference ranges
* Export and share your full lab history
* Access your results anytime, from any device

Professionals can also analyze client data more efficiently and save time managing lab reports.

What test results do you interpret?

Healthmatters.io personal account provides in-depth research on 10000+ biomarkers, including
information and suggestions for test panels such as, but not limited to:
* The GI Effects® Comprehensive Stool Profile,
* GI-MAP,
* The NutrEval FMV®,
* The ION Profile,
* Amino Acids Profile,
* Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones (DUTCH),
* Organic Acids Test,
* Organix Comprehensive Profile,
* Toxic Metals,
* Complete Blood Count (CBC),
* Metabolic panel,
* Thyroid panel,
* Lipid Panel,
* Urinalysis,
* And many, many more.

You can combine all test reports inside your Healthmatters account and keep them in one place. It
gives you an excellent overview of all your health data. Once you retest, you can add new results
and compare them.

If you are still determining whether Healthmatters support your lab results, the rule is that if you
can test it, you can upload it to Healthmatters.

Do you only accept reports from specific labs listed here?

While we work with many popular labs, we welcome reports from lots of other places too.

It's as simple as this: if you can get a test done, you can upload it to Healthmatters and we can
interpret results from any lab out there. If laboratories can analyze it, we can interpret it.

If you're on the hunt for a specific biomarker, [contact us][15] and we'll add it to our database.
Anything from blood, urine, saliva, or stool can be uploaded, understood, and tracked with your
Healthmatters account.

What's the difference between the Advanced and Unlimited plans, and who are they for?

The **Advanced Plan ($79/year)** is perfect for individuals who want ongoing access to their health
data. It includes unlimited self-entry of lab reports, visual tracking, custom ranges, result
explanations, full account exports, and secure sharing — all with a simple yearly subscription. The
plan also includes ** free data entry of up to 5 reports by our data entry team.** You can cancel
anytime and restart your plan whenever you're ready — your data will still be there waiting for you.
You can also upgrade to the Unlimited Plan at any time, with the cost prorated based on what you've
already paid.

** The Unlimited Plan ($250 one-time)** is also designed for individuals but offers lifetime access
with no ongoing subscription. You'll get all the same features as the Advanced Plan, plus **free
data entry of up to 10 reports by our data entry team**, making it a great choice if you prefer a
one-time payment and long-term use without yearly fees.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

regulatory standards.

# ООО "ПроКардио"

Мы специализируемся на поставках изделий медицинского назначения и расходных материалов для
интервенционной кардиологии, эндоваскулярной и сердечно-сосудистой хирургии, нейроваскулярной
хирургии, аритмологии, эндохирургии и кардиохирургии от ведущих мировых производителей.

# ООО "ПроКардио"

Мы специализируемся на поставках изделий медицинского назначения и расходных материалов для
интервенционной кардиологии, эндоваскулярной и сердечно-сосудистой хирургии, нейроваскулярной
хирургии, аритмологии, эндохирургии и кардиохирургии от ведущих мировых производителей.

Мы - это:

## Высококвалифицированная команда и многолетний опыт работы

Мы являемся официальными дистрибьюторами и импортерами всемирно известных компаний как “Medtronic”,
”Vitatron”, “Asahi Intecc CO., LTD”, “Merit Medical Systems, Inc”, "Lepu Medical Technology",
“Biosensors International Group”, “Shunmei Medical CO.,LTD“, “Meril Life Science” и “Teleflex”.

Тесное и долгосрочное сотрудничество с Производителями мирового уровня обеспечивает нашим клиентам и
пациентам доступ к передовым технологиям, инновационным разработкам, качественному информационному
сервису и безупречной поддержке.

# About Terumo Penpol Private Limited

Terumo Penpol personifies the story of a home grown R&D initiative commercialized successfully.
Practicing the concept of ” Quality First ” approach in manufacturing, Terumo Penpol has been
serving Blood Centers across the globe for more than thirty years. Partnering with Terumo
Corporation, Japan, a global leader in healthcare products, has enabled Terumo Penpol to harness the
combined strengths in Technology and Manufacturing to continue redefining standards in Blood
Transfusion.With Terumo’s acquisition of Caridian BCT, Terumo has become the world leader in Blood
Management. The Blood Transfusion division of Terumo is being re-organized under the newly acquired
company which has been renamed as Terumo BCT. The Apheresis and Cellular Therapy products of Terumo
BCT complements Terumo Penpol products to provide a full range of blood collection, storage and
processing solutions for Hospitals and Blood Centres in India and other countries.

Peninsula Polymers Private Limited originally incorporated in 1983, converted to Peninsula Polymers
Limited in 1985 and to Terumo Penpol Limited in 1999 when TERUMO CORPORATION acquired majority
shares. TERUMO PENPOL Limited now being the wholly owned subsidiary of Terumo Corporation, is
converted to Terumo Penpol Private Limited.

# About Terumo Penpol Private Limited

Terumo Penpol personifies the story of a home grown R&D initiative commercialized successfully.
Practicing the concept of ” Quality First ” approach in manufacturing, Terumo Penpol has been
serving Blood Centers across the globe for more than thirty years. Partnering with Terumo
Corporation, Japan, a global leader in healthcare products, has enabled Terumo Penpol to harness the
combined strengths in Technology and Manufacturing to continue redefining standards in Blood
Transfusion.With Terumo’s acquisition of Caridian BCT, Terumo has become the world leader in Blood
Management. The Blood Transfusion division of Terumo is being re-organized under the newly acquired
company which has been renamed as Terumo BCT. The Apheresis and Cellular Therapy products of Terumo
BCT complements Terumo Penpol products to provide a full range of blood collection, storage and
processing solutions for Hospitals and Blood Centres in India and other countries.

Peninsula Polymers Private Limited originally incorporated in 1983, converted to Peninsula Polymers
Limited in 1985 and to Terumo Penpol Limited in 1999 when TERUMO CORPORATION acquired majority
shares. TERUMO PENPOL Limited now being the wholly owned subsidiary of Terumo Corporation, is
converted to Terumo Penpol Private Limited.

## About Vindicta

**VINDICTA** is a modern metal band formed by vocalist Grace Pasturini **(Lilith)** alongside
guitarists Amber Maldonado **(Lamia)** and Patri Grief **(Rusalka)**. Bringing together heavy riffs,
cinematic atmosphere and strong melodic hooks, the band blends power and emotion into a sound shaped
by modern metal, performance and storytelling.

Now joined by bassist Wena Velasco** (Medea)** and drummer Gemma Sofia Salvatori** (Kali)**,
VINDICTA has grown into a fully realised international project, with members based across Italy,
Spain and the United States. Combining different influences and backgrounds, the band shares a clear
creative vision and an ambition to build something lasting.

Following the release of their debut single, *The Face of the Clown*, VINDICTA quickly gained
attention from fans drawn to both their sound and identity. The release marked the beginning of a
new chapter, establishing the foundations of the band’s own musical direction while signalling much
more to come.

Alongside new original material, VINDICTA’s live performances also feature selected songs previously
performed by members of the band, including material from *Gospel I*, reimagined within a renewed
concept and sound. With a focus on powerful live shows, strong visuals and artistic freedom,
VINDICTA is building something bold, ambitious and distinctly its own.

[The Face of the Clown single artwork]

## About Vindicta

**VINDICTA** is a modern metal band formed by vocalist Grace Pasturini **(Lilith)** alongside
guitarists Amber Maldonado **(Lamia)** and Patri Grief **(Rusalka)**. Bringing together heavy riffs,
cinematic atmosphere and strong melodic hooks, the band blends power and emotion into a sound shaped
by modern metal, performance and storytelling.

Now joined by bassist Wena Velasco** (Medea)** and drummer Gemma Sofia Salvatori** (Kali)**,
VINDICTA has grown into a fully realised international project, with members based across Italy,
Spain and the United States. Combining different influences and backgrounds, the band shares a clear
creative vision and an ambition to build something lasting.

Following the release of their debut single, *The Face of the Clown*, VINDICTA quickly gained
attention from fans drawn to both their sound and identity. The release marked the beginning of a
new chapter, establishing the foundations of the band’s own musical direction while signalling much
more to come.

Alongside new original material, VINDICTA’s live performances also feature selected songs previously
performed by members of the band, including material from *Gospel I*, reimagined within a renewed
concept and sound. With a focus on powerful live shows, strong visuals and artistic freedom,
VINDICTA is building something bold, ambitious and distinctly its own.
